paragraphs.text: Sindbad was a famous human explorer from Rabiah , who once used a giant flying bird as a means of transportation, tying himself fast to one of its enormous claws.

In One Thousand and One Nights , the inspiration for the set Arabian Nights , Sinbad was a famous sailor and adventurer. When first printed in Arabian Nights , Sindbad had the unique Creature type of Sindbad . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Human .
